raw: {"need": "Competence", "secondary": {"name": "Identity"}, "read": "Going quiet and doing the bare minimum is almost never laziness. It is usually a young person who has decided, somewhere beneath the surface, that trying and failing in front of you is worse than not trying at all. The silence is self-protection. The identity piece shows up in the background: they may be quietly asking whether any of this connects to who they actually want to become, and if the answer is unclear, effort feels pointless.", "pull": {"collapse": "Protector", "instinct": "Give them space, lower the bar, stop pushing because you do not want to add pressure to someone who already looks depleted. This removes the friction but also removes the message that you believe they have more in them, which is exactly what they need to hear."}, "mentorMove": "Hold the standard where it is, but get curious about what the withdrawal is covering. You are not looking to catch them being lazy; you are looking for the spot where confidence broke down, and that conversation has to happen one to one with no audience and no agenda except finding out.", "holdFirm": ["The minimum is not the ceiling and you are not going to pretend it is.", "You staying in the relationship, paying attention, is not optional just because they have gone quiet."], "stayFlexible": ["Where and when you have this conversation, on their terms if possible.", "How they show you effort, not whether they show it."], "forceLevel": {"level": 2, "label": "Questions"}, "script": [{"phase": "Connection", "words": "I am not going to make this into a big confrontation. I just have noticed you have been quieter than usual, and I miss you in this, honestly. I want to know what is going on with you."}, {"phase": "Curiosity", "words": "I am not asking about the work right now. I am asking about you. What does this feel like from where you are standing? Is there something that has started to feel pointless, or hard, or like it is not worth the risk?"}, {"phase": "Collaboration", "words": "Here is what I want to try. situation: Someone I am responsible for has gone quiet and is doing the bare minimum.
